title: WORLD LARGEST TRADE DATA ONLINE PLATFORM
content: Detailed Data Detailed Customs Data contains 100% shipment information including company details. We provide detailed customs data of 62+ countries online, including Angola, Turkey, Thailand, Bangladesh, Burundi, Bolivia, DR Congo, Ethiopia, Fiji, Ghana, Guatemala, Guyana, Indonesia, Mexico, Nicaragua, Philippines, Russia, Singapore, Ukraine and many more. Customs data is useful to find importers & exporters, monitor trade activities of competitors and gain in-depth market insights. Statistical Data Statistical Data covers useful shipment information such as Date, Quantity, Price, Country and so on, but No Company Names. You can access statistical data of 48+ European Union nations and other countries . Statistical data is useful to find potential market, determine market price of every commodity which companies import & export globally and analyze market share of countries. Mirror Data Mirror Data contains data of those countries whose direct data is not available and re-structured on the basis of data of their partner countries. Our database covers 190+ countries mirror data that is better than no data. Bill of Lading Data Bill of Lading Data is based on shipping documents and contains companies’ shipment information but pricing details are not available. Suez Canal Bill of Lading Data Suez Canal Data contains bill of lading data of shipments, which move through Suez Canal. You can gain access to 190+ countries Suez Canal BL data. Transit Data Transit Data covers the information on Import-Export Shipments, which pass through different customs territories. We provide transit data of 190+ countries in Asia, Africa, North America, Europe, South America and Oceania. Cargo BL Data Cargo Data is a type of BL data, which is collected from various shipment companies. We provide transit data of 190+ countries in Asia, Africa, North America, Europe, South America and Oceania.

data? Import export data is a collection of stats based on details of shipments that pass through transport modes like sea, air, and road. The data contains Date, Importer Name, Exporter Name, HS Code, Product Description, Origin Country, Destination Country, Port, Value Quantity, Transport Mode, etc. Where can i find import export data online You can find import export data online at Export Genius, a leading provider of 190+ countries’ global trade data, including 62+ countries’ detailed customs data, and 32+ countries’ exclusive data. How do I find export import data? Yes, you can search Bangladesh export/import data by entering correct HS Code at Chapter, Heading or Sub-heading level and view number of shipment records. What type of data I can search here? You can search two types of data – Detailed Customs Data, and Statistical Data. However, in our Dashboard, we provide all types of data – Detailed Customs Data, Statistical Data, Weekly Detailed, Mirror Data, Bill of Lading Data, Cargo BL Data, Suez Canal Data, and Transit Data. Can I search data by Product only? Yes, you can search data by entering name of the product. Can I search data by HS code only? Yes, you can search data by entering HS Code. How many countries covered in your database? Our database covers 190+ countries’ global trade data, including 62+ countries’ detailed customs data, and 32+ countries’ exclusive data. How do I find importers in a country? You can find importers in a country by clicking on the ‘Importer’ button and entering name of the product. How do I find export companies? You can find export companies by clicking on the ‘Exporter’ button and entering name of the product. How do I find foreign buyers for export? You can find list of foreign buyers for export and view shipment details of your selected buyer. You can also get our subscription to access our dashboard and get complete shipment information on foreign buyers. title: Frequently Asked Questions
content: Frequently Asked Questions About Our Platform and Data Show All Hide All What is Export Genius? Export Genius is a leading market research company, providing import-export trade data online of 190+ Countries around the globe. We have 10 years of experience in the industry and the trust that clients have shown in us is commendable. We provide an online platform to access global trade data by Importers, Exporters, Products, and Markets and so on that is presented in neat, meaningful and relevant charts for having quick analysis. How many countries’ data can I access on Export Genius? You can access 190+ Countries Import-Export Data online, including Detailed Customs Data of 62+ Countries . So, keep a tab on every import and export activity of global businesses. How many countries’ exclusive data is available in your database? We provide 32+ Countries’ Exclusive Data - Angola, Armenia, Bangladesh, Bolivia, Brazil, Burundi, Cameroon, Chad, Costa Rica, DR Congo, Dominican Republic, Ghana, Guatemala, Guyana, Iran, Kosovo, Liberia, Maldives, Malawi, Mexico, Nicaragua, Niger, Nigeria, Sao Tome and Príncipe, Sierra Leone, Senegal, Singapore, Syria, Tanzania, Turkey, Thailand, Uzbekistan, Zimbabwe, Fiji and Zambia. So, get exclusive data of countries and discover new market prospects. Check data availability . How many types of data do you provide? We provide 7 types of import-export data – Cargo BL Data, Customs Data, Statistical Data, Mirror Data, Bill of Lading Data, Suez Canal Bill of Lading Data and Transit Data. Learn More Customs Data contains company names, besides other shipping details like HS Code, Product, Port, Origin/Destination Country and so on. Statistical Data covers Date, Quantity, Price, Quantity, Country, etc. to analyze market price of goods and other trade aspects. Mirror Data is a data of non-reporting countries and restructured from data reported by their partner countries. Bill of Lading Data is based on shipping documents and covers company details & other shipment information, but pricing is not covered. Cargo BL Data Cargo Data is a type of BL data, which is collected from various shipment companies. Suez Canal Data contains bill of lading data of shipments, which move through Suez Canal. Transit Data Transit Data covers the information of import-export shipments, which pass through different customs territories. Can I access the contact information of companies and their employees? Yes, you can access contact details of companies and their employees including – Name, Designation, Direct Phone Numbers, Email Addresses, and Locations. Can I search data online? Yes, you can search data online by HS Code, Product Description or both, Importer, Exporter and Market Trends. Click on search data. So, gain instant access to global trade data anywhere and at any time. What is the source of data, its authenticity and accuracy? Export Genius assures you of the best data quality in the industry. The data is based on actual Shipping & Custom documents like Bill of Lading & Shipping Bills and collected from several Custom Departments, Government Bodies and other partners. The data thus goes through quality check process to ensure that you get the most accurate and pertinent data. How frequently the database is updated? We update data of most of the countries in every month, but time may vary country to country. Get the latest import-export data that matters to your business. How Export Genius is different from other market research online platforms? Export Genius differs from other market research online platforms because of comprehensive data coverage, exclusive information, easy data access and other unique features of dashboard. 190+ Countries’ Import Export Trade Data Available 62+ Countries’ Detailed Customs Data Available 32+ Countries’ Exclusive Data Access 10M+ Contacts of Companies’ and Their Employees Covered 20+ Filters to Search Data Online Customized Plan and Pricing Available as per Your Requirement Data Visualization by HS Code, Product, Importer, Exporter, etc. How can Export Genius help my business? Our market intelligence online platform is useful to global businesses for finding importers & exporters, tracking competitors’ shipments and keeping a close market watch by accessing global trade data online. Learn More How can I get in touch with Export Genius team for any assistance? You can get in touch with us for any assistance via various contact options – +91 8003 8003 57 (Mobile), +91-11-47048012 (Landline), +91-11-47048013 (Landline), +91-11-47048014 (Landline), +91 8003 8003 57 (WhatsApp) and [email protected] (Email Address). You can also convey your query through ‘Chat Box’. You can also schedule a demo. Plans and Pricing Show All Hide All What are the data plans you offer? We offer 4 different data plans – Starter, Essential, Expert and Customized Plan. Compare plans . Can I get a free trial? Yes, you will get a free trial. You can also schedule a demo . How does the point system work for my data download? The point system is divided into monthly plans only. Consumption of points varies in each country and data that is available in plan you choose. What are the payment modes? You can pay us via PayPal, Wire Transfer, Debit card, Credit Card, Bank Transfer, Demand Draft, Cheque and Cash Deposit in Company’ account. All payment will be in favour of Export Genius, New Delhi, India. What are the terms of payment? The payment will be 100% in advance only. How can I contact you for creating my Customized Data Plan to suit my requirement and budget? You can easily reach us through [email protected] or Live Chat. Our experts will understand your data requirements and suggest plans specifically tailored to suit your needs.
